source_prompt_scope: User requested many additional CoTerm candidates spanning resilience, benefits, substrates, media, CoVIA, evolution and speculative relations
promotion_rule: Separate human and CoLex review must establish distinctness, use case, counterexample, source and receiver benefit before registration. Similarity requires merge/alias/retirement, not automatic new global names.
relation_to_existing: Extends CoTermForge and CoZillion grammar as an append-only candidate set; does not replace public glossary or preexisting CoHysteresis/CoHysterIs terms.
